name: Jezero delta-front EVA
elevationDatum: Source HiRISE DTM MOLA topography / DeltaGeoid, meters; retain published vertical datum

targets.title: Sol 645 · delta approach
targets.rationale: Observe the terrain documented at the sol 645 rover stop and compare its Jezero fan 2 unit regional context with nearby CRISM summary parameters. The geological boundary has 100–200 m registration uncertainty.
targets.activity: Record surface texture and stratigraphic context; proposed EVA observation, not a historical rover activity.
targets.evidence: Rover PLACES site 31, drive 856; 4 locally stored surface photographs with exact site/drive camera positions.

sources.title: Mars 2020 Science Investigation CTX DEM Mosaic
sources.attribution: USGS Astrogeology Science Center, NASA PDS, and product authors
sources.processing: Crop to AOI, preserve as contextual DEM, derive metadata.
sources.limitations: 20 m contextual DEM; not the local routing surface.

sources.title: Mars 2020 Terrain Relative Navigation HiRISE DTM Mosaic
sources.attribution: USGS Astrogeology Science Center and NASA/JPL/University of Arizona
sources.processing: Read AOI by HTTP range, crop at 1 m, derive 5 m routing grid.
sources.limitations: 1 m stereo DTM resampled to a 5 m analysis grid; unresolved rocks and stereo artifacts remain.

sources.title: Mars 2020 HiRISE Orthorectified Image Mosaic
sources.attribution: USGS Astrogeology Science Center and NASA/JPL/University of Arizona
sources.processing: Read AOI by HTTP range and resample to 1 m.
sources.limitations: 0.25 m grayscale orthomosaic resampled to 0.5 m for the browser.

sources.title: Geologic Map of Jezero Crater and the Nili Planum Region
sources.format: ZIP containing GIS database and metadata
sources.license: Public domain except where noted in source
sources.attribution: Sun, V.Z., and Stack, K.M., 2020, USGS SIM 3464
sources.processing: Extract GIS database, select geologic units, clip to AOI.
sources.limitations: Regional 1:75,000 interpretation, with documented 100–200 m offset from controlled mosaics. Excluded from traversal cost.

sources.title: Jezero CRISM Map-Projected Targeted Reduced Data Record summary cube
sources.format: ENVI IMG, HDR, PDS label, and PDS4 XML
sources.crs: Mars equirectangular with latitude of true scale 15 degrees
sources.attribution: NASA/JPL/JHUAPL CRISM team and PDS Geosciences Node
sources.processing: Extract OLINDEX3, D2300, and MIN2295_2480 indicators and align to AOI.
sources.limitations: 18 m native pixels shown using nearest-neighbor sampling; 5 m display does not increase mineral resolution. Indicators are not mineral ground truth.

sources.title: Mars 2020 Rover PLACES best interpreted localization
sources.processing: Filter ROVER frames to AOI and simplify the traverse.
sources.limitations: Planetocentric geographic coordinates transformed to the common Mars sphere. A rover track does not certify astronaut safety.

sources.title: Curated Perseverance surface images
sources.crs: Locations inherited from Rover PLACES for the matching sol
sources.processing: Select deterministically, download medium browse image, create <=1600 px thumbnail.
sources.limitations: Images joined to exact rover site/drive; camera position is not the photographed footprint.

sources.title: MEDA seven-sol historical context window
sources.crs: Non-spatial time-series observations at the rover location
sources.attribution: Rodriguez-Manfredi et al., Mars 2020 MEDA, DOI 10.17189/1522849
sources.processing: Aggregate min, mean, max, and observation count by sol; historical context only.
sources.limitations: Sols 307–313 precede this local traverse. Historical context at the rover then; not a forecast or local-time recommendation.

assumptions.energy: Abstract heuristic model units; not measured astronaut energy
assumptions.science: Proposed observation priorities and visit durations are assumptions

processing.rasterAlignment: All analysis arrays share the exact same 81×81, 5 m transform
processing.crismResampling: nearest, preserving native 18 m footprint limitations
processing.elevationResampling: bilinear to 1 m, 5×5 mean to 5 m
processing.nodata: No unmeasured pixels are allowed as traversable
processing.roughness: 3×3 standard deviation of 5 m elevation, normalized by 95th percentile
processing.geology: Full source geodatabase reprojected/clipped, not used for navigation
